name: Story 4: reviewing teammates' PRs
description: Teammates ask me for reviews. An agent prepares a brief; I review and post. Reviews given recently stand in for goodwill, which (in the desk model) speeds up reviews of my own PRs. Time unit: a working hour; horizon four weeks.

stocks.name: Briefed
stocks.note: Pre-read brief ready: what changed, risk, likely bugs, related commits

stocks.name: Review written
stocks.note: My review written, comments waiting to be posted

stocks.name: Reviews given (goodwill)
stocks.note: Reviews I gave recently. Stands in for reviewer goodwill toward me; decays over about two weeks.

stocks.name: Agent budget
stocks.note: Agent budget. Refilled at $3 per working hour (about $120 a week) from the $190 weekly total.

flows.name: pre-read brief
flows.note: Pre-read the change and prepare a brief

flows.name: my review
flows.note: Review it myself (the verdict is mine)

flows.name: weekly budget
flows.note: Weekly budget, spread over working hours

machines.name: Me
machines.note: About 60% of my working hours are free for this work; the rest is meetings and duties not modelled.

machines.name: Analyst agent
machines.note: Research, context, stakeholders, runbooks, root cause. Ad hoc sessions.

machines.name: Drafter agent
machines.note: Tickets, PR descriptions, replies, Slack and Jira messages. Everything it writes goes to my outbox.

machines.name: Implementation agents
machines.note: Two worker slots. Code, tests, fixes.

machines.name: Orchestra programs
machines.note: Probes, routing, pings, labels, pattern-matched SAIL triage. No model calls.
